Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
  • Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
    • Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies

  • Leadership & team development
  • Delegation, accountability & follow-through
  • Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
  • Schedule-health oversight & workload management
  • Workflow optimization & accuracy
  • Efficient decision-making & prioritization
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy

Work Environment

Benefits

About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

jobs.title: Senior PR Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

jobs.title: Senior ATE Test Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Senior Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Test Engineer, you will own the bring-up and operation of our high-volume 300 mm wafer test infrastructure for electronic-photonic integrated circuits. On a daily basis, you will set up and qualify ATE test cells, develop and debug test programs for DC, RF, and electro-optical device characterization, and drive probe card design with vendors. You will analyze wafer-level data to make pass/fail calls and share insights with design and process teams, helping us scale from engineering characterization to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Set up, qualify, and calibrate ATE test cells, ensuring readiness for high-volume wafer testing.

  • Develop and debug automated test programs for DC, RF, optical, and electro-optical device characterization, including new measurement methods.

  • Own probe card specifications, design, qualification, and integration, alongside associated interface hardware, in collaboration with vendors.

  • Collaborate across teams to define comprehensive measurement plans and contribute to design-for-test (DFT) implementation.

  • Collect, analyze, and report wafer-level measurement data to determine pass/fail outcomes and support yield monitoring, reliability testing, and failure analysis.

  • Transfer laboratory characterization methods into production, developing automated test protocols and equipment specifications for manufacturing integration.

  • Optimize test throughput while maintaining measurement accuracy and reliability.

  • Work with manufacturing engineering to implement statistical process control (SPC), improve yield, and strengthen test efficiency and data analytics.

  • Support supplier qualification, vendor evaluation, and incoming material characterization.

  • Create test documentation and training materials, ensuring procedures meet industry standards and customer quality requirements.

Your Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

  • At least five years of hands-on experience setting up and operating ATE systems, including wafer probers and probe card specification, qualification, and integration.

  • Strong programming skills in Java and Python for test automation, instrument control, and automated data collection.

  • Hands-on experience performing electrical, optical, and electro-optical measurements on EIC and PIC devices; RF or high-speed testing experience is a plus.

  • A sound understanding of PIC and/or EIC device structures and operation, including EIC-to-PIC interface architectures.

  • Practical knowledge of design-for-test (DFT) methodologies and their implementation in integrated circuits.

  • A proven track record of transferring laboratory test methods and device characterization into production environments.

  • Proficiency in data processing, statistical analysis, and visualization using Python, Java, or LabVIEW, with experience applying statistical process control (SPC) and monitoring yield, process performance, and reliability.

  • Knowledge of supplier management, incoming material characterization, and vendor qualification processes.

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup or semiconductor manufacturing environment is preferred.

  • Advanced knowledge of optoelectronic device physics, graphene-based devices, and semiconductor operating principles is an advantage.

  • Familiarity with photonic component qualification methodologies and industry reliability testing standards is a plus.

  • Experience characterizing and testing optoelectronic or semiconductor packaging is an advantage.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

jobs.title: Stress Engineer - Non-linear & Propellants
jobs.description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Stress Engineer to support structural sizing and simulation with a focus on non-linear and thermomechanical analysis of solid rocket motor structures.

A core part of this role is the structural simulation of propellant grains, liner bonds, thermal protection systems (TPS), and propellant–liner–casing interfaces – combining FEA with material characterization and test correlation to build substantiated models of energetic material assemblies.

What You’ll Do

· Conduct stress analysis using both classical hand-calculation methods and FEA – linear and non-linear, static and dynamic

· Simulate solid rocket motor structures: propellant grain stress and strain fields, bond integrity at propellant–liner and liner–casing interfaces, TPS thermomechanical response, and igniter/nozzle attachment loads

· Conduct non-linear simulations covering geometric non-linearity, material non-linearity (plasticity, hyperelasticity for propellant and elastomeric materials), and contact mechanics

· Perform thermomechanical analysis across metallic, composite, bonded, and polymeric structures under thermal cycling and operational loads

· Support experimental characterisation of propellant, liner, and bonded joint materials; feed test results (lap shear, peel, tensile, and DMA data) into material models and allowables

· Correlate FE predictions against strain gauge, load, and thermal test data; validate and update models accordingly

· Prepare stress reports, margin-of-safety calculations, and design justification documentation

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 3–5 years of industry experience in stress analysis of aerospace or mechanical structures

· Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct/HyperWorks for both linear and non-linear analysis

· Strong classical stress analysis skills: beam theory, buckling, fastener and joint analysis, margin-of-safety calculations

· Experience with non-linear material modelling – plasticity, hyperelasticity, or viscoelasticity; familiarity with propellant or elastomeric material constitutive models is a strong advantage

· Experience with thermomechanical or thermal-structural analysis

· Experience correlating FE predictions with experimental test data

· Background in solid rocket motor, propulsion, or energetic structures is a strong advantage

· Fluent in English; German or French is an advantage

jobs.title: SEO Manager (m/w/d) – Content & Kundenprojekte
jobs.description:
Du bist verantwortlich für folgende Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest unsere eigene organische Sichtbarkeit, von der Keyword-Strategie bis zur fertigen Seite in Webflow oder WordPress. Zusaetzlich bringst du dein SEO-Handwerk, technisch, inhaltlich und beim Linkbuilding, in Kundenprojekte unseres Managed Service ein, wenn dort echte Umsetzung gebraucht wird. Je nach Projekt kann das auch direkten Kontakt zum Kunden bedeuten, im Kern bleibst du aber fuer die Umsetzung zustaendig, nicht fuer die Kundenbeziehung. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschaeftsleitung und dem Einkauf.

In deinem Bereich entscheidest du nach vorheriger Einarbeitung ohne Ruecksprache.

Deine Aufgaben

  1. Content-Flaeche ausbauen – Money-Pages, Branchenseiten, Glossar und Blog auf Basis bestehender Keyword-Maps und Briefings.

  2. Schreiben auf Fachniveau – Texte, die ranken und von ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Overviews als Quelle genommen werden.

  3. Selbst bauen und live stellen – neue Seiten in Webflow oder WordPress, ohne auf Entwicklerkapazitaet zu warten.

  4. Technisches SEO und GEO – Struktur, interne Verlinkung, Schema, Ladezeit, KI-Zitierbarkeit, auf unserer Website wie auf Kundenprojekten.

  5. Kundenprojekte mitoptimieren – technisches SEO, Content und Linkbuilding-Strategie, wenn ein Kundenprojekt echte Umsetzung braucht.

  6. Messen statt vermuten – monatlicher Status gegen Non-Brand-Traffic, rankende Keywords, Positionen der Money-Keywords, live gestellte Seiten.

Du arbeitest taeglich mit Claude Code. Webflow, Ahrefs und Google Search Console sind direkt angebunden, du ziehst Daten, baust Seiten und laesst Analysen laufen, ohne zwischen Tools hin- und herzuspringen.


Das bringst du mit

Uns ist die Person wichtiger als der Lebenslauf.

  1. Erfahrung mit Ergebnissen – drei bis fuenf Jahre SEO inhouse oder in einer Agentur, und du kannst an einem Projekt zeigen, was du bewegt hast.

  2. Breite statt nur eine Disziplin – technisches SEO, Content und Linkbuilding sind fuer dich ein Werkzeugkasten, kein Gegensatz.

  3. Umsetzungsstaerke im Web – Webflow oder WordPress bedienst du sicher, inklusive Gefuehl fuer Layout und Struktur.

  4. Tempo durch Systeme, nicht durch Handarbeit – du willst mit KI eigene Prozesse fuer SEO bauen, statt drei Tage an einem einzelnen Blogartikel zu sitzen. Das musst du heute noch nicht beherrschen, die Richtung muss stimmen, dahin entwickelt sich die Rolle mit dir.

  5. Ownership und Flexibilitaet – du wechselst ohne Reibung zwischen eigener Website und Kundenprojekt, je nachdem wo es gerade brennt.

Zur Einarbeitung bist du bei uns im Buero in Bonn-Ramersdorf, danach 3 zu 2.


Wir bieten dir nicht nur einen Job, der Spaß macht, sondern eine Chance zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung:

  1. Ein Projekt mit echtem Hebel – die eigene Website gehoert dir, was du baust, bleibt und waechst weiter. Dazu Abwechslung durch Kundenprojekte.

  2. 40.000 - 60.000 Euro Euro variabel – bei Zielerreichung, gekoppelt an deine Ergebnisse.

  3. Modernes KI-Setup – Recherche, Datenaufbereitung und Analyse nimmt dir unsere KI-Infrastruktur ab.

  4. Kurze Wege – direkt mit der Geschaeftsleitung, nicht ueber drei Ebenen.

  5. Perspektive – unbefristet, in einem Markt, der gerade erst anfaengt. Wer diesen Bereich bei uns aufbaut, waechst mit ihm.

  6. 30 Tage Urlaub – dazu die 3-zu-2-Homeoffice-Regelung nach der Einarbeitung.

So laeuft deine Bewerbung ab

Schick uns zwei bis drei Seiten oder Artikel, die du selbst geschrieben und live gestellt hast, mit einem Satz dazu, was sie erreicht haben. Das sagt mehr als jedes Anschreiben.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

The opportunity

Checkout.com helps businesses thrive in the digital economy by making payments work better. Within Payment Performance, Data Science is central to how we improve acceptance, reduce payment costs and protect merchants and Checkout from fraud.

The teams already exist and are building important products. Your job is to help them work as one organization, raise the bar for how models are developed and operated, and turn more of their work into measurable production impact.

You will lead a distributed group of Data Scientists working on real-time decisioning at global payments scale. The problems range from fraud detection and adaptive risk strategies to authorization optimization, routing and recovery. The common thread is using machine learning to make better decisions on every payment.

This is a player-coach role. You will set direction and develop the organization, but remain close enough to the work to challenge technical choices, lead design reviews and contribute directly when the problem calls for it.

What you’ll do

Set the Data Science strategy

  • Decide where we should invest across models, data, experimentation and shared capabilities to create the greatest business impact.

Turn models into production impact

  • Improve measurable outcomes across fraud, acceptance and payment cost, with models that operate safely and reliably at scale.

  • Ensure teams optimize for business and merchant outcomes rather than research output or offline model metrics alone.

  • Partner with Engineering leaders on the architecture and capabilities needed for low-latency, resilient ML systems.

  • Spend time with merchants when direct technical engagement can uncover a better problem, build confidence or demonstrate value.

Lead and grow the organization

  • Lead, coach and develop Data Scientists across Fraud and Acceptance, initially managing much of the team directly.

  • Create clear ownership, goals and development paths across a distributed organization.

  • Develop future domain leads who can take on more day-to-day technical and people leadership as the teams grow.

  • Hire exceptional scientists and build a culture that combines scientific rigor, pace, curiosity and accountability.

  • Create an environment where senior scientists can challenge assumptions, do their best work and connect it to outcomes that matter.

Stay close to the science

  • Act as a technical sounding board for senior scientists across modelling, experimentation and ML-system design.

  • Lead or contribute to design reviews, prototypes and selected analyses where your involvement can materially improve the outcome.

  • Challenge teams to choose practical methods that fit the business problem, rather than defaulting to the most complex approach.

  • Keep the organization current on developments in applied AI and machine learning, and translate relevant advances into production opportunities.

What success looks like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • United the Fraud and Acceptance teams behind one Data Science strategy and operating model.

  • Improved the production impact of models across fraud, acceptance and cost optimization.

  • Established clear decision rights and an effective joint roadmap with Product and Engineering.

  • Raised standards for model development, productionization, monitoring and measurement.

  • Created stronger consistency across the teams while preserving the expertise each domain requires.

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare, you’ll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run.

In regulated industries, relationships are the currency, so we’re looking for a leader who already knows the buyers and the rulebook. You’ll have the mandate to win net-new logos, drive agent sales, and build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive adoption of ElevenLabs, including closing deals yourself and also building and scaling the team

  • Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution

  • Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment

  • Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies

  • Open doors through your own network of senior buyers, and turn early wins into the references the rest of the vertical will call

  • Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one

  • Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run

  • Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling

  • Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call

  • Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

  • Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy

  • Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, including at least 2 years leading a team.

  • Track record selling into health systems, payers, or life sciences, with deep fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, AI governance, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • An established network of senior decision-makers in one or more of health systems, payers, or life sciences, so you can name the buyers you’d call in your first 30 days

  • Experience building a new sales motion or playbook from scratch, whether as a founding leader or inside a larger company

  • Passion for experimenting to find the positioning and messaging that wins in market, and turn what works into the playbook

  • Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex sales cycles

  • Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once

  • Executive presence at C-suite and board levels

  • Low ego and hands-on: equally at home in a C-suite briefing and in the weeds of a prospecting list or Proof of Value. Motivated by impact and growth more than title

  • Passion for the transformative potential of voice and conversational AI

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.

This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.

On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.

This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.

In this role you will

  • Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.

  • Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases.

  • Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer.

  • Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why.

  • Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions.

  • Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

  • Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

  • Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

  • Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

  • Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.

  • 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.

  • Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

  • Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

  • Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.

  • Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective.

  • Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives.

  • A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor.

  • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work.

  • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We're changing how the world moves money. Wallets are where that change becomes real: the first place millions of people truly own their money. You'll own design execution across our wallets, working directly with the Design Lead to shape where they go next.

Responsibilities

  • Own design execution end to end: from concept and prototype to launch and iteration.

  • Turn complex, conceptual ideas into experiences that feel simple to someone using a wallet for the first time.

  • Prototype fast and often: high-fidelity and interactive, in days not weeks, using the best tools available, AI included.

  • Partner daily with product, engineering and research, and present your work clearly to leadership.

  • Raise the bar for quality across everything we ship.

  • Contribute to strategic decisions about the future of our wallets.


  • 5+ years of product design experience, with real time shipping live products in wallets, crypto or fintech.

  • Mastery of your craft: visual design, interaction design and prototyping.

  • Fluency in Figma and modern prototyping tools, including AI tools to accelerate ideation.

  • A working understanding of crypto networks, fees and self-custody, and how they shape what users experience.

  • A plain-language instinct: you make complex things feel obvious.

  • Proactive by default: you spot problems early and arrive with solutions.

  • You thrive in a genuinely fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment. We ship weekly.

  • Experience designing for emerging markets or first-time financial users is a nice to have.

  • Design systems experience at scale is a nice to have.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
Darum geht's

Als Senior HR Generalist*in (w/d/m) berichtest du direkt an unsere CFO/COO Tania. Du bist alleinverantwortlich die treibende Kraft für unsere Angestellten, weltweit! Als Generalist*in deckst du alle Aspekte der Personalarbeit in unserem Scale-up ab. So hast du eine umfassende Wirkung auf jeden Aspekt im Employee Lifecycle. Und on top bewirkst du etwas Gutes!


Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior HR Generalist*in (w/d/m)…

  • kümmerst du dich um das HR daily business: Vertragsänderungen, Statements, Anfragen, Elternzeit und Offboarding, und das für drei Gesellschaften über Ländergrenzen hinweg (DE,CH,BE)

  • erweckst du unsere Company Culture zum Leben und trägst somit auch zu einer hohen Retention bei: durch Events, dem Feiern von Meilensteinen aber auch durch die Durchführung unserer jährlichen Satisfaction & Pulse Survey

  • unterstützt du im Bereich Learning & Development: du hältst den Feedbackprozess, hast ein Auge auf unser LMS-Tool (innform) und bist zentrale Anlaufstelle für Personalentwicklung

  • verantwortest du das Recruiting von A bis Z: posten, screenen, koordinieren, Verträge erstellen, einstellen und schlussendlich auch das Onboarding, alles aus einer Hand

  • bist du Sparrings-Partner*in für unsere Führungskräfte: du berätst bei personal- und arbeitsrechtlichen Fragestellungen, einschließlich der Begleitung von Trennungsprozessen

  • unterstützt du die vorbereitende Lohnbuchhaltung bei Bedarf (normalerweise wird diese vom Finance-Team übernommen)


Dein Profil

  • Abschluss oder Ausbildung im Personalwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Psychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich

    • Tools wie GSuite oder Office, wünschenswert: Asana, Confluence

    • Mitarbeiterentwicklung ist ein großes Plus

  • Souveräner Umgang mit Führungskräften verschiedener Seniorität (Von Junior Team Lead bis C-Level), Verständnis für deren Belange und lösungsorientierte, wertschätzende Beratung

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1 Niveau (Wort und Schrift), Englischkenntnisse auf B2 Niveau (Wort und Schrift)

Nice to have: 

  • Erfahrung bei der Organisation größerer Team Events

  • Kenntnisse im Belgischen Arbeitsrecht

  • Französischkenntnisse


Deine Learnings

  • Du wirst dein Wissen in allen Bereichen der Personalarbeit vertiefen und so Expert*in in vielen Themen

  • Du lernst, Personalthemen in einem internationalen, remote first Unternehmen über Ländergrenzen hinweg zu gestalten


Warum RaiseNow

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung und Alter.

  • Eine zukunftsorientierte Tätigkeit in einem sinnvollen Umfeld mit einem internationalen Team

  • Genieße viel Flexibilität in Bezug auf deine Arbeitszeit und -ort: Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Jahresarbeitszeit sowie die Möglichkeit, zeitweise im Ausland zu arbeiten - und das alles in einem Remote-First-Setup

  • 5 Wochen bezahlter Jahresurlaub + zusätzliche Urlaubstage pro Jahr mit RaiseNow + dein Geburtstag als zusätzlicher Urlaubstag

  • Wir wissen, dass Zeit kostbar ist: Wir sind Teil der Pledge-1%-Initiative, bieten Sabbatical-Optionen und einen jährlichen Bildungsurlaub für alle

  • Deine Gesundheit ist wichtig: Durch unseren Partner Instahelp erhältst du kostenfreien Zugang zu psychologischer Beratung wenn es dir mal nicht so gut geht

  • Die Vorteile eines Scale-ups: kurze Entscheidungswege, transparente Kommunikation und regelmäßige Teamevents + eine Workation pro Jahr, um das gesamte Team an einem Ort zu treffen 

  • Ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Kultur der Transparenz, des Vertrauens und des gegenseitigen Respekts

  • Projektautonomie und Raum für persönliche Entwicklung von Anfang an


KI Hinweis: 
Wir nutzen Software, um Bewerbungen zu strukturieren und relevante Erfahrungen schneller zu erkennen. Die Bewertung basiert auf Kriterien zur ausgeschriebenen Stelle. Eine Absage oder Einladung wird nicht allein durch die Software entschieden.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Talent Acquisition (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Finoa, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG.


Deine Mission

Direct Search ist dein Spielfeld. Du findest die Menschen, die gerade gar nicht suchen, aber genau die Richtigen für Aampere wären. Über LinkedIn, GitHub, Communities und alles, was dir sonst noch einfällt.
Outreach, auf den Leute antworten. Du schreibst keine Copy-Paste-Nachrichten. Du findest den einen Aufhänger, der zeigt: hier hat sich jemand wirklich mit mir beschäftigt. Deine Antwortquote ist dein persönlicher Ehrgeiz.
Recruiting end-to-end mitsteuern. Du begleitest Kandidat:innen für Intern-Rollen durch den gesamten Prozess: Screening, Interviews, Feedback einsammeln, nachhalten. Du sorgst dafür, dass niemand im Funnel verloren geht und jede:r jederzeit weiß, woran sie oder er ist.
Erstgespräche, die zählen. Du führst First-Round-Interviews und triffst fundierte Einschätzungen. Du erkennst, ob hinter einem starken CV auch ein echter Fit steckt, und gibst dem Team eine Einordnung, auf die es sich verlassen kann.
AI-First Sourcing. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand ein Tool in die Hand drückt. Juicebox, Clay, whatever next. Du testest eigenständig, was uns schneller zu den besten Talenten bringt, und machst Sourcing bei Aampere smarter, als es gestern war.
Sparring mit Benni und den Gründern. Du arbeitest direkt mit Benni Aampere's Founder's Associate an der Frage, wen Aampere als Nächstes braucht. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, statt abzuarbeiten, was reinkommt.


Das bringst du mit

Dein Background. Du bist eingeschriebene:r Studierende:r im Bachelor oder im Master. Idealerweise hast du schon mal in einem Startup, einer Beratung oder im Venture Capital reingeschnuppert.
Kommunikationsstärke. Du schreibst Nachrichten, auf die Menschen antworten, und führst Gespräche, nach denen Leute Bock auf Aampere haben. Klar, professionell, auf den Punkt.
Ownership. Du brauchst wenig Anleitung und viel Gestaltungsfreiraum. Du packst an, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Themen verlässlich ins Ziel, statt auf die nächste Ansage zu warten.
Struktur. Direct Search heißt: viele Profile, viele Threads, viele offene Loops gleichzeitig. Du behältst den Überblick und lässt nichts liegen.
Neugier. Du interessierst dich für Startups, Tech und die Frage, was großartige Teams von mittelmäßigen unterscheidet. Nicht weil es im Jobprofil steht, sondern weil du nicht anders kannst.
Verfügbarkeit. Idealerweise hast du 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns. In den Semesterferien gerne mehr.
Sprache. Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen

Vertrauen und Ownership: Du bist nicht hier, um jemandem zuzuarbeiten. Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt. Intern steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle.
Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten – direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad.


Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams.


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.

...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.

...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.

...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Wie wir arbeiten

Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.
Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen.
Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.


Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss

Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam.

jobs.description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo.


Deine Mission

Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.

Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen
Tech: Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.
Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. 


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.

...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.

...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.

jobs.title: Product Manager (m/f/d) - For Relentlessly Ambitious People
jobs.description:
Your mission

This is not a normal job. Please read this part before you read anything else.

If you are highly driven, extremely ambitious, and you want to do the work of your life at a company that will change how people get access to new therapies and shared medical knowledge, mama health is the place for you.

If not, this role is not for you. This is why:

  • You will be in the office 5 days a week. Berlin HQ. Not hybrid. Not "flexible". We build together, in the same room, every day.
  • You will work a lot. More than at most jobs. We do not count hours, we count what we ship and what it changes for patients.
  • You will give some of the best years of your life to this. In return, you get ownership, speed, and a problem worth your time.
  • You will get obsessed with metrics. Not dashboards for a weekly meeting. Real obsession: why did this number move, what does it mean for a patient, what do we change tomorrow.

Why do we ask this much? Because today, patients spend years to reach the right therapy. We want to help every patient reach their best possible care faster: understand their own situation, get clear information about it, and get access to the best tools, therapies, and treatments in the world. This is generational work not work for everyone. It will change your life and the lives of millions of other people.


This role is built to grow into Head of Product. How fast depends on you.

- - - - - 


As a Product Manager at mama health, you will shape and execute product of one of the most exciting AI companies in healthcare. You will work closely with the founders, engineers, designers, and medical experts to build products that help patients understand their diseases, and that help healthcare organizations learn directly from patient experiences at scale.

This is an execution role. You will be expected to take ownership, turn ambitious goals into shipped products, and keep a high pace.

You will be responsible for driving product development from idea to launch while ensuring alignment across teams and maintaining a high pace of execution.

You will:

  • Own product initiatives from discovery to delivery and iteration
  • Write your own SQL queries, build your own analyses, and find the "why" behind every metric
  • Define success metrics for everything you ship, and own the result
  • Translate company goals into clear priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans
  • Work closely with engineering, design, AI, and medical teams to ship high-quality products on time
  • Drive day-to-day execution, remove blockers, and keep projects on track
  • Talk to patients and customers, and turn what you learn into product improvements
  • Write product requirements and user stories
  • Help build product processes that scale as we grow


Your profile

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in a product role (Product Manager, Associate PM, Product Analyst, Product Owner, or a founder who shipped a real product)
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and analytics tools (for example Metabase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, or similar). You do not wait for a data team to answer your questions.
  • Proof that you ship: products, features, side projects, anything real
  • Highly driven, proactive, and execution-oriented. You do more than people ask.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem solving
  • You learn fast and you like to be out of your comfort zone
  • Clear communication with engineers, designers, and business people
  • Fluent English is required. German is a nice to have.
  • Experience in AI, healthcare, digital health, or SaaS is a nice to have.
  • Based in Berlin or ready to relocate fast.


Why us?

  • A real path to Head of Product. We hire for where you can be in 2 years, not only for where you are today.
  • Ownership from day one. You will not wait for permission to do important work.
  • A mission that matters. Every metric you move is a patient who gets better information, faster.
  • A team that plays hard too. Regular team events, sports benefits, shared learning, and our annual team retreat.
When you join our team, you'll be part of a forward-thinking company that values integrity, collaboration and results-driven work.  Join us and be part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to improving healthcare outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer – Business Automation (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir verantworten u.a. das zentrale CRM HubSpot, über das alle Prozesse unserer Wertschöpfungskette laufen. Interne Software-Produkte integrieren sich genauso in unsere CRM-Infrastruktur wie spezifische Apps, z.B. zur Terminbuchung bei einer Kundenanfrage. Der nächste Skalierungs-Schritt erfordert einen noch stärkeren Fokus auf technisches Enablement unserer eigenen Organisation sowie den Ausbau und die Verbesserung unseres eigenen technischen Verantwortungsbereichs.

Du übernimmst dabei eine gewachsene, produktive Automatisierungslandschaft: Ein Teil unserer Geschäftslogik läuft heute als Custom Code direkt in HubSpot-Workflows, ein Teil in eigenen Backend-Services. Beides gehört dir – und du gestaltest aktiv mit, wohin sich diese Architektur entwickelt.

Softwareentwicklung

  • Entwicklung TypeScript-basierter Automatisierungen und Services entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette im HubSpot CRM

  • Entwicklung von HubSpot-Apps und UI Extensions (React) für unsere internen Teams – von CRM-Cards bis Workflow-Actions

  • Verwaltung von Scopes, Token-Rotation, App-Versionierung und Deployments (CI/CD)

Automatisierungen & Workflows

  • Entwicklung und Betrieb von Custom-Code-Automatisierungen, die als Teil von HubSpot-Workflows laufen – inklusive Pflege der Workflows selbst (Trigger, Enrollment-Kriterien, Fehlerbilder)

  • Bewusste Platzierung von Logik: Du entscheidest, was in einen Workflow gehört, was in Custom Code und was in einen Backend-Service – und migrierst Logik dorthin, wo sie testbar und wartbar ist

  • Analyse und Behebung von Incidents in der bestehenden Automatisierungslandschaft, inklusive Datenkorrekturen und Backfills per Skript

API- & Event-getriebene Architektur

  • Einsatz der HubSpot CRM APIs für Objekte, Assoziationen und Batch-Operationen

  • Nutzung von Webhooks & Subscriptions für Event-getriebene Synchronisation

  • Aufbau robuster Retry-, Error-Handling- und Monitoring-Mechanismen – inklusive bewusstem Umgang mit Rate-Limits und Datenvolumen

Datenmodellierung & CRM-Architektur

  • Definition von Objektbeziehungen, Ownership-Logiken und Lifecycle-Zuständen

  • Sicherstellung von Datenkonsistenz über mehrere Systeme hinweg

Integrationen & Plattform-Strategie

  • Technische Anbindung interner sowie externer Systeme (z.B. Abrechnung, Metering, Energie-Backends, eigener Tech Stack)

  • Aufbau sauberer Schnittstellen zwischen HubSpot und produktiven Kernsystemen

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung der langfristigen CRM- & Integrationsarchitektur – inklusive der schrittweisen Verlagerung komplexer Geschäftslogik aus Workflows in testbare Backend-Services



Dein Profil

Software-Engineering

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Web-Anwendungen, mit klarem Schwerpunkt Backend

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript; solide React-Kenntnisse für unsere CRM-Cards und UI Extensions (NestJS ist ein Plus)

  • Erfahrung mit REST-APIs, asynchronen Systemen, Queues und Event-Verarbeitung

  • Verständnis für saubere API-Verträge, Versionierung und Testing – du weißt, wann ein Pattern hilft und wann es Zeremonie ist

Systemdenken: Automatisierung & Skalierung

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit API- und Event-getriebener Integration von SaaS-Plattformen (CRM, Billing o.Ä.) – praktische Erfahrung mit der HubSpot Developer Platform (Private/Public Apps, OAuth 2.0, Scopes, Webhooks, UI Extensions) ist ein starkes Plus

  • Erfahrung im Design skalierbarer CRM- und Integrationsarchitekturen; du kannst HubSpot sinnvoll in eine größere Systemlandschaft einbetten

  • Bewusstsein für sinnvolle Automatisierungen, Performance, Plattform-Limits und Datenvolumen

Arbeitsweise & Ownership

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit KI-Assistenten und verantwortest das Ergebnis: Du entscheidest, was du delegierst, und reviewst, was zurückkommt

  • Unvollständig definierte Tickets schrecken dich nicht ab: Du willst wissen, wer ein Feature nutzt und warum, klärst offene Punkte aktiv und sagst auch mal Nein zu Features, die sich nicht rechnen

  • Ownership-Mindset statt Ticket-Abarbeitung: Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen, gibst dein Wissen weiter und fühlst dich in Startup-Strukturen wohl

  • Teamorientiert und direkt in der Kommunikation; einen technischen Trade-off kannst du auch einer nicht-technischen Person aus Product, Operations oder Management erklären

  • Sprachen: Deutsch mindestens auf B2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift


Warum wir?

  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Genieße maximale Flexibilität mit der Möglichkeit zur hybriden Arbeit in Hamburg - Dabei würden wir uns gerne 1-2 Tage im Office treffen, die restlichen kannst du remote arbeiten

  • Mobil unterwegs: Zuschuss zu Deutschlandticket oder Einzelfahrscheinen, plus Bikeleasing per Gehaltsumwandlung – günstig zum eigenen Wunschrad, 100% privat nutzbar.

  • Fit & gesund: Mit unserem Urban Sports Club-Zuschuss trainierst Du deutschlandweit in tausenden Studios und Kursen, von Yoga bis Klettern.

  • Vorsorge: Wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge – für Deine Zukunft nach metergrid.

  • Gemeinschaft: Regelmäßige departmentübergreifende Events an unseren Standorten bringen das ganze Team zusammen.

  • Gestaltungsfreiraum: Wir sind ein motiviertes Start-up-Team ohne Hierarchieebenen. Bei uns kannst Du Deine Ideen umsetzen und den Kurs aktiv mitbestimmen.

  • Wachstumschancen: Deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung ist uns wichtig – wir bieten Dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten, Dich in neue Richtungen zu entwickeln.

  • Sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Du arbeitest nicht nur für einen Job, sondern für eine Mission: die Energiewende. In fünf Jahren kannst Du stolz sagen, dass Du Teil davon warst!

  • Schnelle Lernkurve und Eigenverantwortung: Von Tag 1 an bist Du mitten im Geschehen. Wir setzen auf Dich und Deine Fähigkeiten und unterstützen Dich in Deiner Entwicklung.

Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird.

Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung.

Are you a hands-on commercial finance professional who owns the numbers, challenges assumptions, and turns insights into action? If so, read on.

  • Profitability & Trade Terms: Analyse profitability by customer, channel, product, and promotion. Review discounts, bonuses, listing fees, and trade marketing spend, and back customer negotiations with scenarios and minimum targets.
  • Budget Monitoring: Track D2C, Retail, Field Sales, and Trade Marketing budgets, flag risks early, and turn deviations into concrete recommendations.
  • S&OP Interface: Represent commercial planning in our monthly S&OP cycle: challenge demand assumptions, link commercial signals to supply constraints, and prepare decision-ready scenarios.
  • Data, Tools & Automation: Improve data quality and KPI definitions, automate recurring work in Google Sheets and our planning tools, and use AI and systems like APS to simplify processes and sharpen decisions.


YOUR PROFILE

  • Several years in Sales Controlling, Commercial Controlling, FP&A, or similar, with hands-on ownership of sales budgets, forecasts, rolling plans, and plan-versus-actual analyses.
  • Solid grasp of net sales, contribution margin, customer and channel profitability, and trade terms (discounts, bonuses, listing fees, trade marketing). You've built KPI dashboards and consistent cross-channel reporting yourself.
  • Strong Google Sheets skills, plus experience with BI, ERP, CRM, and planning tools such as Odoo or APS. A doer and builder who has used automation or AI to improve data quality and cut manual work.
  • Analytical, structured, and pragmatic: comfortable with imperfect data, quick to challenge assumptions, and focused on turning insights into action. 
  • Collaborative and low-ego, while keeping owners accountable for their inputs.
  • Fluent German and confident English.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience in an FMCG company.

Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

This role is based in Hamburg or Berlin, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we'd love to get to know you!

YOUR PROFILE

jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has developed and executed a scaled customer motion, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

 

What You'll Do:

You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will:

  • Improve the scaled adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scale customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work.
